title: A fresh start for an aging deck
description: The same backyard, before and after. Weathered wood boards gave way to new composite decking with a clean border and dark railing.

title: From weathered stairs to a finished backyard
description: Two views of the same home: the original wood deck and the completed deck, with new stairs, dark railing and lattice below.

title: Old wood deck to a clean new deck
description: A tired, gray wood deck replaced with new boards, railing and a fresh look.

title: Screened porch to an open composite deck
description: An enclosed, worn porch opened up into a low composite deck with clean edges.

title: Faded stairs to black aluminum rail
description: Weathered stairs and rail rebuilt with white risers and black aluminum railing.

title: Front steps to a covered entry porch
description: Bare front steps turned into a covered porch with columns and new stairs.
